key.nonick.copy: Copy real name of player in crosshair
text.autoconfig.nonick.title: NoNick settings
text.autoconfig.nonick.option.enabled.@T: Master switch. Turn it off to see the server's names exactly as sent.
text.autoconfig.nonick.option.replaceNam: Replace the name above a player's head. Team colors and prefixes stay.
text.autoconfig.nonick.option.replaceTab: Replace names in the player list you open with Tab.
text.autoconfig.nonick.option.replaceCha: Replace the sender name in player chat. The message text is not touched.
text.autoconfig.nonick.option.replaceSys: Replace nicknames in join, leave, and death messages. Only your screen changes.
text.autoconfig.nonick.option.keepDecora: Keep prefixes, suffixes, team colors, and click actions. Turn it off to replace the whole name with the real one.
text.autoconfig.nonick.option.showNickna: Append the nickname in gray, for example Steve (xX_Nick_Xx).
text.autoconfig.nonick.option.notifyOnJo: Print a short chat note when a nickname is detected.
text.autoconfig.nonick.option.mojangLook: Ask Mojang which account owns an online-mode UUID. This is the only way to recover a nickname that replaced the profile name. Offline-mode UUIDs have no Mojang account, so they are skipped.
text.autoconfig.nonick.option.cacheHours: How long to keep a Mojang answer. Stored in config/nonick-names.json.
text.autoconfig.nonick.option.debugLog.@: Write detection details to the game log when a name looks wrong.
text.nonick.status: NoNick is %s. %s players are using a nickname. Cached Mojang lookups: %s.
text.nonick.not_ready: NoNick is still starting up. Try again in a moment.
text.nonick.not_found: No player on this server matches %s.
text.nonick.toggle.on: NoNick is on. Names above heads, in the tab list, and in chat now use real account names where they are known.
text.nonick.toggle.off: NoNick is off. You are seeing the server's names again.
text.nonick.detected: The server calls this player %s. Their account name is %s.
text.nonick.list.empty: No nicknames found on this server.
text.nonick.list.more: and %s more. Use /nonick who <name> for one player.
text.nonick.lookup.pending: Checking Mojang for the account behind %s. This can take a few seconds.
text.nonick.clear.done: Cleared the name cache and the current player list.
text.nonick.copy.none: Look at a player first, then use the copy key.
text.nonick.config.failed: The settings screen could not open. Check the game log for the reason.
